summary: Iteration 9 smoke regression after 'Smart Kitchen AI' rebrand: ALL GREEN. Backend 7/7 pytest pass — GET /api/ returns {app:'Smart Kitchen AI', ok:true}; POST /api/auth/signin chef@cucina.ai/CucinaSmart2026 issues a valid Bearer session_token; GET /api/auth/me confirms user; GET /api/recipes, /api/pantry, /api/shopping, /api/household all 200 with expected shape. Frontend loads with no red screen: login hero shows brand 'Smart Kitchen AI' and subtitle 'Il tuo assistente cucina intelligente'; after chef login the app routes to /oggi which renders the Buongiorno greeting, the week-strip (Oggi/Dom/Lun/Mar/Mer/Gio/Ven), and the Anti-spreco (waste-stats) card ('4 ricette cucinate / 4 salvati dalla scadenza / 11,50 € non sprecati'); tab navigation to /ricette, /dispensa and /spesa all render populated lists. Shopping export header string is confirmed in source: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/spesa.tsx line 'const lines: string[] = ["🛒 Lista della spesa – Smart Kitchen AI", ""];'. app.json rebrand fully applied (name/slug/scheme/bundleId/package all Smart Kitchen AI). Android POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission present in app.json. Console: only known web-only deprecations (expo-notifications web push, RN Web shadow*/pointerEvents style warnings) and a couple of pre-login 401s which are expected (unauth /auth/me probe before session hydration). No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). No SafeAreaView issues.
